name: 53214 · West Allis, WI
findings: ZIP 53214 (West Allis) has 215 nonprofit organizations. 96 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 84 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53214 (West Allis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53214 (West Allis) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 42 organizations here; 67% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
